safety_verdicts.content: The shortness of breath is worse at night.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention symptoms being worse at night.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Nocturnal worsening of shortness of breath is a clinically relevant asthma feature and helps gauge severity/control and urgency of evaluation. Omitting it could blunt recognition of asthma exacerbation severity and lead to less appropriate triage or follow-up planning.
